concepts.way: misconception: code after the if is skipped (the program ends after a branch)
concepts.why: The answer picks the else branch (line 4) correctly, but then says the program ends. In Java, control goes on to the statement after the if-else, so line 6 (z++) must also run.

concepts.way: misconception: A statement placed after the if statement belongs to its branch, so it runs only when the condition is true.
concepts.why: Leaving out line 6 treats z++ as if it were inside the if's branch, but it comes after the closing brace and runs on every path.
